note: Tier 2 of AGENTIC-FIRST-PLAN.md §10, widened by Tier 5. Each brief is a task an agent is asked to do, plus what a correct answer must contain. `must` are strings that have to reach the RENDERED page — the check that content declared is content rendered, which is the defect this whole project has been removing. `forbid` are strings that must NOT appear: placeholder content leaking is a silent failure that looks like success. `source` says where a brief came from: `invented` briefs were written by the same person who wrote the checks, which is a real weakness; `relays` briefs are derived from the structure and copy of an existing production site nobody wrote for this eval. Multi-page briefs carry `pages` instead of `must`/`forbid`.
